type_definitions.name: ArtifactDisposition

workflows.description: post-generation import minimization, compatibility audit, reverse informalization consistency, declaration-shape/non-vacuity/cross-file consistency, line-comment guard, realness gate, unified consistency report, and statistics.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered artifact_acceptance_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared artifact_acceptance_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by artifact_acceptance_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Prepare and ground a Lean artifact, reconstruct its meaning, test independent consistency criteria, and issue the acceptance disposition controlling reports and documentation.
reasoning_projection.name: ReviewLeanArtifact

occurrences.rationale: Produce a review identity with controlled imports and source-aware comments.
Relate artifact concepts and imports to applicable mathlib declarations.
Assess abstraction and API compatibility against the established grounding.
Conservatively reconstruct statements and proof summaries from the Lean artifact.
Assess preservation of conditional, existential, uniqueness, and equivalence structure.
Assess reverse proof packets for placeholders, circularity, and proof-shape contradictions.
Assess agreement among source claims, comments, reverse meaning, and Lean signatures.
Assess axioms, false-premise vacuity, target-restating hypotheses, and trivial wrappers.
Assess declaration collisions and divergent concept families across the artifact corpus.
Aggregate required layers and realness findings into a scoped acceptance disposition.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: acceptance warrant only; statistics and documentation remain downstream material effects
